analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 242,250) above SMA5 (KRW 235,950), below SMA20 (KRW 244,588), and below SMA50 (KRW 290,745) — diagnosing short-term bearish and mid-term bearish trends.
· Below SMA100 (KRW 261,033), above SMA200 (KRW 197,711) — indicating a bearish bias in the medium-to-long term.
· 52-week position (56.9%) — located in the historical mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.4→46.3) — neutral sustained, exiting oversold zone and consolidating.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-181.6715→1874.0562) — improvement confirmed, weak convergence continues.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band KRW 244,588) — consolidating around the middle band, with a band width of 30.98%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (KRW 240,000) — based on Pivot (KRW 238,650) and 5-day low (KRW 227,500).
· Swing resistance level (KRW 267,000) — potential for breakout attempt if 5-day high (KRW 254,500) is surpassed.
· 5-day price range (KRW 254,500 / KRW 227,500), 20-day price range (KRW 284,500 / KRW 189,200) — no clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern formed, indicating a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.68x) — contracted volume compared to the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — consolidating within the range between the 240,000 support and 267,000 resistance levels, requiring a wait-and-see approach until directional confirmation.
